<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> Lok Sabha leaders are meeting today to address the status of pending critical legislation, including the FCRA and the Women’s Reservation Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral administration:</strong> The Election Commission of India has announced it will require formal declarations for fresh applications from individuals who failed to submit enumeration forms.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Financial regulation:</strong> The Lok Sabha has passed a bill authorizing the government to permit banks to levy charges on UPI transactions.</li>
  <li><strong>Women&#x27;s representation:</strong> The Congress party is urging the NCP (SP) to pressure the Prime Minister for the immediate implementation of the Women’s Reservation Act.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Energy policy:</strong> BJP MP Janardan Mishra has publicly defended the government&#x27;s ethanol-blending policy amid ongoing debates regarding fuel quality and standards.</li>
</ul>
